_default_provider_note: null = 不预设供应商。AI 在用户未指定时必须先向用户询问用 packyapi 还是 apimart（见 SKILL.md）。

packyapi.label: packyapi — OpenAI 兼容 / 同步返回 b64 / 像素尺寸(无真16:9) / 有独立 edit 端点

capabilities.edit: supported (image[+mask]+prompt -> image) via /v1/images/edits; accepts mask/quality/output_format/background/multiple images; GLOBAL regeneration (mask guides, not pixel-freeze)

apimart.label: apimart — 异步任务制 / 比例尺寸(真16:9) + resolution(1k/2k/4k) / 结果为URL(24h) / 编辑走 image_urls

capabilities.generate: supported (async: POST /v1/images/generations -> task_id; poll GET /v1/tasks/{id} until status=completed; image at data.result.images[0].url[0])
capabilities.edit: no separate endpoint; pass reference/edit images (https URL 或 data:image/png;base64,...，最多16张) via image_urls in the generation request

notes: model is gpt-image-2 on both providers. 单张出图较慢(60-180s)，客户端超时给足。两家请求/响应协议不同，详见各 provider 的 mode 与 SKILL.md。
